_comment: Shared conformance vectors for the Stellar escrow digests. One fixture, three readers: the Rust contract tests (escrow/src/test_conformance.rs), Go (encoding/conformance_test.go) and TypeScript (src/conformance.test.ts) must each reproduce every `digest` from `input`. Generated OUT OF BAND by conformance/regenerate_vectors.py from docs/witness-layouts.md (own keccak-256, own strkey encoder, `cryptography` ed25519); never regenerate from the output of an implementation under test, and never edit by hand. A layout change is a reviewed vector bump: see the header of regenerate_vectors.py and contracts/encoding-parity.md. Amounts, nonces and times are decimal strings so no reader loses precision above 2^53.
